result:
This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent the case, so I built and solved nothing. I did not substitute another unit.

The case needs a `ReaktoroRedoxEquilibrium` unit. That unit takes water and acid feeds and returns an equilibrated aqueous solution with redox couples and speciation. `list_models` offers no such unit. The available models are mixers, splitters, heaters, flashes, a conversion reactor, a kinetic CSTR, pumps, valves, heat exchangers, feed sources and product sinks. None of them does aqueous geochemical equilibrium or tracks redox species.

The Feed and Product nodes would map onto `feed_source` and `product_sink`. Without the equilibrium unit, the redox couples, species states and equilibrium response can't be produced.

{"case_id": "reaktoro_redox_tracking", "status": "limitation", "revision_id": null, "job_id": null, "limitation": {"reasons": [{"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "ReaktoroRedoxEquilibrium"}], "explanation": "The case's central unit, ReaktoroRedoxEquilibrium (aqueous Reaktoro redox/speciation equilibrium of water plus acid), has no counterpart among the OpenFlowsheet unit models. The available units are mixers, splitters, heaters, TP/PH flashes, a conversion reactor, a kinetic CSTR, pumps, valves, heat exchangers, feeds and sinks. None performs aqueous geochemical equilibrium or tracks redox couples and species. Building the case with any of them would be a substitute, so nothing was built."}, "claims": []}
